kind: specification errata. The protocol file is frozen and hash-pinned, so an error in it is corrected by this file, never by an edit; this file is itself a frozen record (tools/check_append_only.py), so a later correction is a new file. idxsig.e5.check_implementation applies each entry and refuses any E5 stage whose effective specification differs from the code.

errata.what: The v1.1 freeze (5d7be0c) redefined features.age_definition to count age from listed_before (finding B) but left the raw-input list at v1's ten entries. The code it froze, 53447ca, takes eleven: moonshot_e5.FEATURE_ARGS ends with listed_before, and the rule refuses to run without it.
errata.numbers_affected: None. The v1.1 outputs (99f3c5f) were computed by that code with all eleven inputs; this entry corrects the specification to what was run.
errata.unchanged: features.order (the 41 model columns) and every other key. The 'feature list' that addendum.unchanged calls identical to v1 is features.order.
errata.found_by: independent review of PR #8 (2026-10-15), confirmed against the code
